title: HATH0R Voice Action Contract v1
description: Standardized contract for voice-driven intent recognition, routing, and dispatch across platforms and agents in HATHOR.

action_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this voice event/action

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of transcription/action generation

transcript.description: Raw transcribed text of the user's spoken utterance

routing_tier.description: Tier that resolved this action: system_one (fast sub-50ms deterministic router, e.g. Jev) or system_two (deliberate agent reasoning)

confidence.description: Confidence score from 0.0 to 1.0 of the classification

platform.description: Target or host operating system environment

args.description: Arguments to pass to the command or tool

target.description: Target application, window, UI element, or agent identifier

feedback_text.description: Spoken acknowledgment or response returned to user

metadata.description: Optional telemetry, latency measurements, and session context

model_id.description: Identifier of the model or router engine (e.g. typesafe-jev-v1, active-agent)
